name: Fey Dragon Scale
summary: Around Stonetalon Peak, faerie dragons yield scales coveted by Jin'Zil. The Darkspear witch doctor uses one as a reagent in a brew that mocks night elven nature magic.

sections.title: A Rare Forest Harvest
sections.body: Around Stonetalon Peak, faerie dragons haunt the wild groves of Kalimdor. Their scales gleam with natural magic. Night elves revere them as harmless woodland spirits and allies, while outsiders prize the scales as rare magical ingredients.

sections.title: A Mocking Concoction
sections.body: At Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil mixes a brew that mocks kaldorei traditions. He combines a fey dragon scale with tree sap, feline whiskers, and dozens upon dozens of courser eyes, calling the result 'forest magic.' He means the cruel concoction for the three night elves he keeps caged.

faq.q: Where does this scale come from?
aliases: where to find fey dragon scale
faq.answer: The scale comes from faerie dragons in the highland groves around Stonetalon Peak, including Wily Fey Dragons and Nal'taszar.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Jin'Zil want a fey dragon scale?
aliases: what is the scale used for
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil in Malaka'jin wants the scale with other woodland reagents for a brew he sneeringly calls 'forest magic,' meant for his caged night elf prisoners.

faq.q: What happens when Jin'Zil finishes his brew?
aliases: what does jin'zil do with the brew
faq.answer: Jin'Zil plans to use the finished brew on his three captive night elves. When he carries out that plan, the fate of his prisoners is revealed.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know faerie dragons as treasured companions and forest guardians of the kaldorei. Seeing their scales taken for a troll witch doctor's deadly mockery is an outrage to nature.
As a member of the Horde, you help Jin'Zil secure the Horde's footing in the Stonetalon Mountains and strike at the night elven presence higher on the slopes.
